description:
## Goal
Move the private `Fetcher::RedirectLoopError` exception out of `src/vug/fetcher.cr` into a dedicated file.

## Why (SRP)
`RedirectLoopError` is a small but distinct concept: it signals that the fetch loop has detected an infinite redirect chain. It is raised in `prepare_request` and caught in `fetch_loop`. As a private constant in `fetcher.cr` it is hard to spot when reading the file top-to-bottom, and there is no obvious place to attach documentation or future fields.

## Approach
1. Create `src/vug/fetch_errors.cr` (a home for any future fetch-loop errors).
2. Move the `private class RedirectLoopError < Exception` block (lines 20-28 of `fetcher.cr`) into the new file as `Vug::RedirectLoopError` (no longer `private` to `Fetcher`; visibility is the only meaningful change).
3. Add `require "./fetch_errors"` to `fetcher.cr`.
4. Re-export from `src/vug.cr`.

## Acceptance
- `RedirectLoopError` is defined in `src/vug/fetch_errors.cr`.
- The class is reachable as `Vug::RedirectLoopError`.
- The existing rescue in `fetch_loop` still catches it (no behavior change).
- All fetcher specs pass.

## Notes
- This is a low-risk move. The exception is only raised and caught inside `Fetcher`; no external code references `Fetcher::RedirectLoopError`.
title: Extract RedirectLoopError to its own file
